'''I-O8 Operator''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] from [[Iokath]] refurbished for use by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
I-O8 Operator appears in the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] as a Cartel companion available from the Steadfast Champion Pack, added with Patch 5.2.0.
